d: All India Students’ Association (AISA) president Neha Bora addressed a press conference in New Delhi titled “Dissecting the Election Commission’s Affidavit”. During the press conference, Bora criticised the ECI’s response, alleging that it was “avoiding questions instead of admitting mistakes”. The Election Commission recently filed a counter-affidavit in the Supreme Court responding to allegations about its functioning and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
